description: This file defines a utility class 'DeflateUtils' for compressing and decompressing strings using the Deflate algorithm within the CalculatorApp namespace.

classes.name: DeflateUtils
classes.description: A static utility class providing methods for compressing and decompressing strings using Deflate compression.

methods.name: Compress
methods.description: Compresses a string into a byte array using Deflate compression.

methods.name: Decompress
methods.description: Decompresses a byte array back into a string using Deflate decompression.
